cards.title: Dates repeat; geometry binds the columns
items: The original FY2025 Q2 report's physical page 3 has Three Months Ended and Six Months Ended groups. Each group repeats Jul 28, 2024 and Jul 30, 2023.

The extractor validates the row, unit, duration/date columns and four amounts using sorted text and measured word geometry. It preserves exact text spans and bounding boxes; ambiguous input is refused.

Four Net income cells are emitted: current-year 3mo 16,599 and 6mo 31,480; prior-year 3mo 6,188 and 6mo 8,232. Source unit: In millions, except per share data. Currency glyph: $; normalized currency unset.

cards.title: A complete explicit tuple, without guessing
items: Each current-year development profile supplies metric, duration_months (3 or 6), period_end (2024-07-28) and the exact source unit literal. Natural-language query parsing is outside this comparison.

Only one exactly matching cell may be selected. Net income profiles return their independently derived cells. Revenue profiles return NO_EXACT_CELL because the standalone sidecar contains only Net income.
Logical inputs and transformations belong to one local Python replay. This sequence illustrates the source/selection contract, not separate network services.

cards.title: Raw presence is a different observation
items: All four frozen development cases retain a verified raw value span and lexical row/duration/date/unit/value presence. The raw chunk contains two Jul 28, 2024 headings.

Lexical presence does not resolve a raw column. Raw deterministic selection and semantic entailment are not evaluated here. The sidecar matches 2 of 4 explicit profiles; the two Revenue profiles remain uncovered.
Candidate values are post-selection source assertions; expected-answer strings do not enter cell discovery or exact-tuple selection.

cards.title: Experimental acceptance stays bounded
items: Nine synthetic controls refuse unsupported or missing qualifiers, duplicate agreeing records, conflicting records and missing unit bindings. They are not a labeled financial negative set; financial false-accept rate is null.
Status: AI-source-reviewed-experimental; reviewer CodexAI; human_acceptance=false; development-exposed. Author tests 45/45; independent comparison tests 24/24; original-PDF/raw-source replay passed.
Ten preserved files stayed byte-identical, including original/old corpora, package sources and the API wheel. No embeddings, model generation, retrieval integration or browser-offset bridge was run.
